bow-att.rapid-fire.enabled.description: From ArrowDmg: automatically charge and release at the configured time. Uses Bow Enhance's existing aim and velocity simulation. Supports bows in either hand.
bow-att.rapid-fire.charge-ticks.descript: Game ticks to charge before releasing. Default: 4 ticks. At normal game speed, 20 ticks is about one second. A short charge does not automatically become a fully charged shot.
bow-att.rapid-fire.hold-only.description: Require the physical use-item key (right mouse by default). When disabled, holding a bow fires automatically without requiring a target. Pauses in screens or while using other items.
move-speed.fake-sneak-status.description: Use an entity interaction to toggle the sneaking state reported to the server.
module.AntiChunkLag.description: Freezes movement when chunks lag and predicts momentum near unloaded terrain.
module.Attack.description: Controls attack targeting, weapon switching, shield breaking and attack reach.
module.AttackAura.description: Automatically attacks nearby targets using target filters and cooldown rules.
module.AutoResync.description: Preserves rotation or momentum, or attempts to teleport back after a server correction. Position preservation is intended for servers without server-side checks.
module.Blink.description: Buffers movement packets and flushes them at intervals or in response to events.
module.CombatExtra.description: Adjusts reach, attack intervals and attacks while riding or shielding.
module.Disabler.description: Manages server compatibility and placement/mining packet queues.
module.ElytraBot.description: Tracks targets in flight with follow, mace dive and spear combat modes.
module.ElytraExtra.description: Controls armor flight, takeoff, firework boosts and elytra damage fixes.
module.ElytraFlight.description: Controls flight direction, thrust, automatic flight and climb angles.
module.ElytraGrimAcc.description: Uses server setbacks for elytra acceleration with velocity limits.
module.ElytraJump.description: Controls low-altitude elytra jumps with obstacle detection and avoidance.
module.FakeBlockManager.description: Manages temporary client block states used by mining and movement helpers.
module.FloatingUtils.description: Provides Grim hovering, elytra slow falling and conditional altitude freezes.
module.InteractExtra.description: Adjusts interaction reach, use cooldowns and held-use behavior.
module.InvExtra.description: Synchronizes equipment attributes during silent item switches.
module.LegacySnapRotManager.description: Coordinates silent rotation and interaction direction for legacy protocols.
module.MineExtra.description: Adjusts break thresholds, cooldowns, double mining and progress rendering.
module.MovExtra.description: Controls movement compatibility, sprint handling and flight-state toggling.
module.NoFall.description: Handles landing state and fall damage using the selected mode.
module.NoGround.description: Controls the ground state reported to the server.
module.NoSlowDown.description: Handles slowdown from item use, sneaking and blocks.
module.PacketMine.description: Mines selected blocks with packet-based breaking, tool switching and double mining.
module.PacketOrderManager.description: Coordinates the order of movement, interaction and combat packets.
module.PlayerStateManager.description: Tracks server-confirmed position, pose and movement state.
module.PositionPredict.description: Configures target prediction for attacks, flight and spears.
module.PostManager.description: Schedules interaction and combat tasks after player movement.
module.QueueMine.description: Queues selected blocks for mining with double mining and target rendering.
module.SpearEnhance.description: Controls spear restarts, speed resets, target focus and visual indicators.
module.TargetSelector.description: Filters combat targets by entity type, friends, teams and priority weights.
att-bot.attack-inv-swap.description: Switches to a weapon when the held item is not a weapon.
att-bot.attack-select-best-weapon.descri: Chooses the best attributes among weapons of the same type in the inventory.
att-bot.auto-handle-use-when-attack.desc: Coordinates item use with attacks when the server does not allow both simultaneously.
att-bot.exact-tp.description: Uses precise teleport targeting instead of the traditional teleport algorithm.
att-bot.legal-targeting.description: Selects how rotation and movement are coordinated for attacks. Teleport reach requires delayed movement targeting.
att-bot.mace-height-multiply.description: Simulates extra falling height for mace attacks. The upstream guidance limits this to 170, or 140/100 with teleport reach.
att-bot.mace-swap.description: Minimum fall distance before an assisted attack switches to a mace.
att-bot.tp-reach.description: Extends attack reach by teleporting toward the target.
att-bot.auto-att-rate.description: Minimum delay between automatic attack cycles.
att-bot.max-at-once.description: Maximum number of targets attacked in one cycle.
att-bot.respect-cooldown.hand.descriptio: Waits for the hand attack cooldown before attacking.
att-bot.respect-cooldown.max-attack-inte: Forces an attack after this interval even if frequent swings or block placement prevent a full charge.
att-bot.respect-cooldown.weapon.descript: Waits for the held weapon cooldown before attacking.
move-safety.auto-resync-distance.descrip: Only preserves position for corrections closer than this distance in blocks. Zero or negative values disable this branch.
move-safety.auto-resync-pos.description: Confirms a nearby server teleport, then uses the original movement path helper to attempt to return to the previous position. Requires the current chunk to be loaded.
move-safety.auto-resync-request-expire-t: How many game ticks an API resync request remains valid. Defaults to ten ticks.
move-safety.auto-resync-request-recursiv: Renews an API resync request at the current position after it triggers. Does not apply to the regular position-preservation branch.
move-safety.auto-resync-rot-modify-packe: Requires Preserve Rotation. Uses zero relative rotation in position corrections and cancels standalone rotation corrections. Otherwise restores local rotation after processing.
move-safety.auto-resync-rotation.descrip: Preserves your view during position or rotation corrections, using local restoration or packet modification.
move-safety.auto-resync-velocity.descrip: Saves velocity before applying a server position correction and restores it afterwards. The position correction itself still runs.
move-safety.log-auto-resync-request.desc: Logs triggered requests submitted by teleport helpers or the movement API. The regular position-preservation branch does not emit this message.
lag-utils.blink.close-delay.description: Delay before automatic shutdown, in ticks. The upstream guidance recommends at most 20 ticks.
lag-utils.blink.elytra-support.descripti: Allows packet buffering while armor flight or elytra controls are running.
attack.att-range.description: Adds to the base attack reach.
attack.shielding-setback-log.description: Reports when the server resets shield use during an attack.
disablers.grim-self-check.description: Enables the legacy self-check behavior after respawn or world change. Its availability depends on the server implementation.
combat-bot.elytra-bot.combat-mace-chase-: Combat Mace Chase Follow Y Bias
Chases only when the vertical target difference exceeds the horizontal difference plus this offset.
combat-bot.elytra-bot.combat-smooth-flig: Experimental steering adjustments during a defensive pull-up.
Experimental steering adjustments during an offensive pull-up.
Scales outward steering together with the combat radius.
Blends the normal steering direction with lateral motion inside combat range to leave the enemy's reach faster.
Disable Smooth Pull-up for Escaping Targets
Disable Smooth Pull-up for Escaping Targets.
The three vector components are minimum dynamic height, change rate and maximum dynamic height.
Use Horizontal Distance for Outward Correction
Use Horizontal Distance for Outward Correction.
combat-bot.elytra-bot.fly-anti-spear-dis: Fly Anti Spear Disable When Using Spear
Fly Anti Spear Disable When Using Spear.
combat-bot.elytra-bot.fly-anti-spear-use: Fly Anti Spear Use Spear Reset When Follow
Fly Anti Spear Use Spear Reset When Follow.
combat-bot.elytra-bot.fly-anti-spear-whe: Fly Anti Spear When Pull Up
Fly Anti Spear When Pull Up.
combat-bot.elytra-bot.mace-max-extra-pul: Mace Max Extra Pull Up Tick
Caps the additional pull-up duration before switching to a dive attack.
combat-bot.elytra-bot.mace-max-follow-he: Maximum tolerated height below the target while following; greater differences trigger climbing.
Blends predicted Y with current Y: predicted Y * weight + current Y * (1 - weight).
elytra.armor-fly.armor-fly-fix-grim-bad-: Armor Fly Fix Grim Bad Packets 1
Armor Fly Fix Grim Bad Packets 1.
elytra.armor-fly.armor-mode.description: On-demand mode swaps only when the server synchronizes gliding. Tick mode swaps on each movement; legacy tick mode uses the older procedure.
elytra.armor-fly.enable.description: Glides while wearing armor. Requires an elytra in the inventory; a hotbar or offhand elytra reduces packet overhead.
elytra.armor-fly.on-ground-fly-only-fire: Allows continued fast movement on the ground while a firework is active.
elytra.armor-fly.pose-fix.description: Corrects the player bounding box and eye height during armor flight.
elytra.armor-fly.render-fix.description: Uses the standing appearance during armor flight.
elytra.custom-fireworks.auto-rescale-fir: Automatically adjusts the firework velocity to the configured limit.
elytra.custom-fireworks.click-firework-u: Uses one firework while gliding when this hotkey is pressed.
elytra.custom-fireworks.firework-auto-us: Uses another firework just before the current boost expires to maintain continuous thrust.
elytra.custom-fireworks.firework-boost-e: Sets velocity to the facing direction multiplied by boost speed while a firework is active.
elytra.custom-fireworks.firework-delay-m: Automatic firework cooldown multiplier: this value * (flight duration + 1).
elytra.custom-fireworks.fly-rocket-on-fi: Fly Rocket On First Off Hotkey
Fly Rocket On First Off Hotkey.
elytra.custom-fireworks.switch-auto-resc: Switch Auto Rescale Firework Algorithm Key
Switch Auto Rescale Firework Algorithm Key.
elytra.elytra-tweaks.auto-start-fly-join: Starts gliding automatically when joining a server while airborne.
elytra.elytra-tweaks.auto-switch.descrip: Equips an elytra automatically on takeoff.
elytra.elytra-tweaks.auto-take-off.descr: Starts the automatic takeoff sequence when pressed.
elytra.elytra-tweaks.auto-take-off-firew: Auto Take Off Fireworks From Ground
Uses a firework when taking off from the ground or water.
elytra.elytra-tweaks.mace-hit-fix-mode.d: Grim mode uses delayed movement targeting. Current tick armor-flight mode handles this independently.
elytra.elytra-tweaks.no-fall-disable-no-: No Fall Disable No Fall Module
No Fall Disable No Fall Module.
elytra.elytra-tweaks.no-fall-when-landin: Attempts to prevent fall damage when landing from elytra flight; armor-flight results depend on server behavior.
elytra.elytra-tweaks.no-kinetic-mode.des: Attempts to reduce wall-impact damage. Grim mode can sacrifice momentum; armor flight already handles this case.
elytra.unbreakable-elytra.enable.descrip: Avoids elytra durability loss. Can reduce momentum under Grim and conflicts with armor flight's built-in durability handling.
elytra.custom-fireworks.motion-amount.de: Magnitude of controlled thrust. The upstream guidance recommends at most 1.7 under server restrictions.
elytra.simple-flight-control.auto-fly.de: Starts flight from the ground and follows the current view direction when no movement keys are held.
elytra.simple-flight-control.hold-jump-t: Minimum number of ticks the jump key must be held before takeoff is attempted.
elytra.simple-flight-control.horizontal-: Compensates for altitude loss during horizontal flight.
elytra.simple-flight-control.motion-lerp: 1 applies the movement input immediately; lower values blend the previous flight direction with the current input.
elytra.simple-flight-control.motion-mode: Chooses no thrust or firework thrust. Firework thrust supports vanilla rockets and configured custom items.
elytra.simple-flight-control.use-floatin: Uses Floating Utils to hover without consuming fireworks while stationary.
elytra.elytra-flight-legit.grim-accelera: Pauses acceleration above this speed and resumes once velocity drops.
velocity-management.floating-utils.grim-: Reports a landing while hovering through a compatible Via protocol. This also resolves accumulated fall distance.
interact-fix.hold-use.description: Continues using the item after releasing the button; pressing it again stops use.
interact-fix.hold-use-start-tick.descrip: Releasing use before this tick count is treated as a short click and does not latch held use.
fast-break.break-threshold.description: Mining progress threshold for sending completion. Some servers accept a value around 0.7.
fast-break.compat-mode.description: Grim compatibility compensates for timing penalties; the packet mode uses an alternate packet sequence. Behavior depends on the server.
fast-break.double-break.description: Lets the server continue one unfinished block while another is mined. Grim mode sets the mining cooldown to 5 ticks.
fast-break.fix-swing-packet.description: Adjusts swing packets; this can reset attack charge.
fast-break.grim-punishment-threshold.des: Threshold for the simulated mining-duration and cooldown penalty score before sending compensation packets.
fast-break.render-current-break-pos.desc: Shows the block used by retained mining progress and double mining.
fast-break.same-block-optimize.descripti: Restores previous progress when returning to the last mined block and advances it using the current tool.
fast-break.silent-break.description: Sends an abort immediately after starting a break to alter the progress visible to other players.
fast-break.use-fake-instant-break.descri: Shows an instant break for blocks that can finish within one tick even when they are not normally instant-mined.
move-safety.disable-stepheight-feature.d: Disables automatic stepping in movement simulation to accommodate server/client step-height differences.
move-safety.grimac-1-21-2-input-features: Coordinates movement input with inventory operations for Grim's newer input checks.
move-safety.grimac-sprint-features.descr: Coordinates sprint state with inventory operations when the server checks sprinting.
move-safety.no-fall.compat-mode.descript: Selects how the module handles landing packets. Compatibility varies by server.
move-safety.no-fall.disable-when-allow-f: Disable No Fall When Flight Is Allowed
Disables fall protection when the server already grants flight permission.
move-safety.no-fall.equipment-id-compat-: Disables this module's fall handling while matching fall-immune equipment is worn.
move-safety.no-fall.safe-distance-modify: Adds to the player's safe fall-distance attribute; shorter falls do not trigger protection.
move-speed.no-slowdown.fake-sneak.descri: Intercepts sneaking input so the server does not process normal sneaking movement.
move-speed.no-slowdown.fake-sneak-mode.d: Selects the protocol handling used for fake sneaking.
move-speed.no-slowdown.fake-sneak-status: Selects how the sneak state is reported; interaction-based handling requires a nearby entity.
move-speed.no-slowdown.when-in-block.des: Removes slowdown caused by being inside blocks such as cobwebs.
move-speed.no-slowdown.when-on-block.des: Uses default block slipperiness for movement.
move-speed.no-slowdown.when-special-bloc: Handles slowdown from special block interactions.
move-speed.no-slowdown.when-with-block.d: Removes movement multipliers from surfaces such as honey blocks and soul sand.
mine-oneblock.ground-deceive.description: Locks movement while mining and reports a landing through a compatible Via protocol, resolving fall distance.
spear-module.reset-spear-speed-rot-enabl: Resets velocity using a compatible Via protocol and aims at the nearest enemy while a spear is in use.
spear-module.spear-auto-restart.descript: Restarts spear use after its damaging time window expires.
attack.att-hostile.description: Also allow entities with active anger even when their type is not selected. Select ordinary passive animals in the type list. Friend and team checks still apply.
attack.att-named.description: Allows named entities after friend-name filtering; otherwise named entities are excluded.
attack.att-teammate.description: Protects teammates detected by scoreboard team or matching leather chestplate color.
attack.friends.description: Regular expression used to exclude matching friend or NPC names.
attack.opposite-attack-multiply.descript: Adjusts selection priority for targets behind the player, including possible server decoys.
attack.player-attack-multiply.descriptio: Increases player-target priority. Zero adds no priority; larger values favor players.
attack.whitelist.description: Select players, animals or other entities in the categorized picker. Defaults preserve the  player and monster rules. Friend, team and invulnerability checks still apply. Advanced regex edits the original configuration.
inventory.expand-backpack-inventory.desc: Suppress close notifications for the player inventory.
inventory.keep-inv.description: Retain the server container when closing its screen.
inventory.move-click-grim-fix.descriptio: Apply movement input synchronization before inventory clicks.
inventory.sprint-click-grim-fix.descript: Synchronize stopped sprinting before manual container clicks.
inventory.packet-limit.description: Per-tick limit for queued inventory tools; ghost-hand swaps follow the  transaction.
inventory.pick-item.description: Pick the pointed player-inventory item through a compatible protocol.
inventory.clear-keep.description: Clear the retained container and synchronize its closure.
att-bot.place-recorder.description: Record player position updates for prediction visualization.
attack.debug-render-prediction.descripti: Display predicted positions and recorded movement paths.
spear-module.fix-old-version-spear.descr: Restore use and animation components for protocol-translated spears.
spear-module.fix-old-version-spear-pierc: Send the  piercing action for supported older protocols.
spear-module.fix-old-version-spear-sound: Restore use and hit sounds for translated spears.
spear-module.replace-via-spear-model.des: Restore the spear item model matching its material.
attack.friend-list.description: Stores SF friend names and aliases.
attack.add-friend-hotkey.description: Adds the player under the crosshair to the friends list.
attack.send-on-add-friend.description: Optionally sends a custom message after adding a friend; %s is the player name.
inventory.pick-item-modifier.description: Hold with the pick item key; unbind to use the main key alone.
widget.attack.attack.use-argument: Attacks use settings from the Attack module
friend.name: Player Name
friend.command-hint: Command: sf-friends list / add / remove / gui
module.BowTp.description: Teleport, release the bow and return using the  movement sequence.
module.BowEnhance.description: Predict target movement and ballistics to adjust bow and trident aim and launch velocity.
module.SpearAttack.description: Bind the Execute Spear Attack key, hold use to charge a spear, aim at a target, then press that key. Enabling the module alone does not attack automatically.
module.Criticals.description: Apply the  packet, freeze and ground simulation modes for melee criticals.
module.ProjectileEnhance.description: Adjust projectile aim, launch movement and trident behavior.
module.GuiMove.description: Allow movement keys in supported screens.
module.Sprint.description: Automatically hold sprint and provide the  directional sprint modes.
module.Velocity.description: Control knockback, explosions, fluid flow, block push and entity push.
module.AntiAXray.description: Periodically send mining interactions around the player to refresh hidden block information.
module.ElytraFinder.description: Scan End ship dragon heads and perform the implemented approach steps. Automatic pickup and pull-up are unfinished in the .
spear-module.spear-attack-hotkey.descrip: This executes an attack and is separate from the module toggle key. Unbound by default. Hold use to charge a spear, aim at an eligible target, then press this key.
chat.literal.[Spear] 参数错误, MaxTp不能小于Dist: [Spear Attack] Maximum teleport distance must be at least the simulated distance.
chat.literal.[Spear] Too far to reach ta: [Spear Attack] No reachable path. Check target distance and nearby obstacles.
chat.literal.[Bow Attack] Can not reach: [Bow Teleport] Cannot reach the target. Check distance and obstacles.
chat.literal.[Bow Aim] Arrow failed to r: [Bow Enhance] The current trajectory cannot reach the target.
chat.literal.[BowEh] Arrow Velocity Simu: [Bow Enhance] Arrow velocity simulation is unavailable in this compatibility mode.
chat.literal.[Proj Aim] Proj failed to r: [Projectile Enhance] The current trajectory cannot reach the target.
chat.literal.[Attack Bot] 当前参数中,不建议将Mace: [Attack] With these parameters, use a simulated mace height of %s or less.
chat.literal.[Attack Bot] 目标攻击位置位于水中,无法执: [Attack] The attack position is in water; mace attack is unavailable.
chat.literal.[Attack Bot] Exact Attack f: [Attack] Exact attack failed; trying common mode.
chat.literal.[AC] 阻挡异常盾牌禁用: [Combat Extra] Blocked an abnormal shield disable.
chat.literal.[NoSlow] 当前模式下需要一个实体以交互: [No Slow] This mode requires a nearby entity to interact with.
chat.literal.目标位置存在方块碰撞冲突, 无法执行tp: [Movement] Blocks obstruct the destination; teleport unavailable.
chat.literal.水平差距过大,当前tp模式无法完成: [Movement] Horizontal distance exceeds this teleport mode.
chat.literal.y 差距过大,当前tp模式无法完成: [Movement] Vertical distance exceeds this teleport mode.
chat.literal.tp行为已经执行, 若出现回弹或者位置不变,则目标位置: [Movement] Teleport sequence sent. An unchanged position or setback means the destination is unreachable.
module.Printer.description: Places schematic blocks, adjusts interactable states and handles water s. Requires Litematica.
module.BlockRotate.description: Corrects hit positions and block orientation for schematic placement. Enable Schematic Orientation Fix for manual easy place; the printer uses the same logic for its own placements.
module.MultiPlaceDisabler.description: Uses the original multiple-placement and interaction queue flush logic. Takes over the matching Disabler handlers while active to prevent duplicate processing.
module.PlayerInputManager.description: Applies timed input and rotation changes by priority. Used by the schematic printer for automatic sneaking.
Automatically places and adjusts blocks to match the schematic.

Preserves the five original synchronization modes. Movement Post captures the placement packet and sends it after updating rotation. Delay Movement is the default. Block orientation uses the Easy Place Fix helpers.
Allows placement targets without an adjacent solid support. Acceptance depends on the server.
Game ticks between scan and placement batches. Minimum one tick, default five. One attempts placement every tick. Valid integer edits are saved immediately.
Maximum successful placement attempts per batch. Limited to one when multiple-placement or rotation conditions do not allow more.
Runs the original inventory restoration action after placing. Otherwise keeps the placement material selected.
Schedules sneaking with the original timing when the supporting block would otherwise be interacted with.
Attempts to match  water and waterlogged states. Automatic empty-bucket refilling is not implemented in the .
Attempts to place ice and then submit it to Queue Mine. Requires the mining queue to be operational.
Uses interactions to adjust supported states such as slabs, snow layers and redstone components. Does not arbitrarily demolish incorrect blocks.
Swings the hand according to the placement result.
Generates nearby candidates and checks placement distance. Defaults to five blocks; interaction reach and schematic render layers still apply.
Marks successful attempts and failed placements in the current batch. A success marker is not server confirmation.
Outline color for locally successful placement attempts.
Outline color when material is missing or placement is unavailable.
block-rotate.enable.description: Processes block orientation corrections while this module is active.
block-rotate.yaw-deceive-compat-mode.des: Selects the original orientation correction adaptation.
block-rotate.rotate-compat-mode.descript: Selects the original placement look-direction adaptation.
Handles temporary target block states registered by other features.
block-rotate.temporary-schematic.client-: Updates the local preview for corrected temporary targets; this is not server confirmation.
Corrects placement packet hit positions and orientation against the Litematica schematic.
block-rotate.litematica-shit-fix.legal-l: Synchronizes placement look direction with the schematic target. The printer temporarily uses this option and restores its previous value.
multi-place-disabler.enable.description: Toggles the independent placement queue module.
multi-place-disabler.current-ac.descript: Selects the server check type used by the original placement restriction logic.
multi-place-disabler.grim-multi-place.de: Enables the original Grim multiple-placement handling and printer batch eligibility.
multi-place-disabler.auto-flush-multi-pl: Flushes the previous placement queue before a new placement using the  logic.
multi-place-disabler.auto-flush-place-br: Flushes pending placements before starting or finishing block breaking.
message.printer.litematica-unavailable: Could not connect to Litematica. Check that Litematica and MaLiLib are installed and compatible.
module.BadPackets.description: Fix duplicate rotation, input and movement states and invalid server packets.
module.BoatVClip.description: Move vertically with an empty boat using the  clipping sequence.
module.BackTrack.description: Delay entity position packets within the configured distance and time limits and render the earlier position.
module.EnderEyeLog.description: Log Eye of Ender directions and calculate possible stronghold locations.
module.ForwardTp.description: Move forward along the view direction, stopping at or moving through an obstacle.
module.SetBackLog.description: Log server position synchronization and server setbacks with configurable formats.
module.Flight.description: Provide creative, motion and jetpack flight modes with flight and walk speed overrides.
module.StepHeight.description: Step onto higher blocks using the  staged movement sequence.
module.AntiLiquid.description: Control movement near water or lava and coordinate armor and elytra switching.
module.BaritoneFix.description: Provide flight, firework, pathfinding and landing compatibility for an installed Baritone.
module.FastCraft.description: Add recipe history, quick output actions and trade information to crafting and trading screens.
module.ChatExtra.description: Adjust chat input limits, history, message formatting and password handling.
module.ClientSideCommand.description: Handle supported vanilla commands locally, including giving items in creative mode.
module.InGuiChatBox.description: Display a chat input field inside containers and other game screens.
quick-move.ignore-move-collision.descrip: Use direct teleportation when enabled; otherwise use the  collision-aware movement path.
quick-move.max-distance.description: Maximum distance per teleport action. The  recommends a value below 200 blocks.
quick-move.quick-move.description: Move forward past the next obstacle.
quick-move.quick-to-wall.description: Move forward to the next obstacle without passing through it.
move-safety.check-setback-packets.descri: Log position corrections identified by a negative teleport ID.
move-safety.log-resync-packets.descripti: Log server position synchronization, including teleportation and movement corrections.
move-safety.flight.antikick.description: Periodically lower the player to address the vanilla floating-too-long check.
move-safety.flight.antikick-period.descr: Interval between the anti-kick movement adjustments.
move-safety.enhance-stepheight.descripti: Enhance stepping over blocks and slabs with the  staged movement, up to about 1.75 blocks.
move-safety.anti-liquid.auto-armor-fly-s: Wait this many ticks after leaving water before switching armor to avoid failed takeoff.
baritone.fix.auto-import-seed.descriptio: Import a known world seed from the local AntiAXray module when available.
Pause the elytra process while hovering, using controlled elytra flight, or holding the pause key.
baritone.fix.baritone-experiment-1.descr: Prefer lower-altitude sections of the calculated path.
baritone.fix.change-landing-to-log.descr: Disconnect instead of landing when an emergency or destination landing is requested.
baritone.fix.dimension-fix.description: Compat the elytra dimension check, not the Nether pathfinder's height limit. Start Y must be 0–127; goal Y must be 1–127. Disable elytraPredictTerrain outside the Nether. Not all terrain is supported.
baritone.fix.disable-inventory-check.des: Support armor flight and unbreakable elytra while checking firework reserves. During navigation, SF Elytra Flight yields direction and speed; armor-flight fireworks use the equipment-swap queue. SF control resumes afterward. Conditional pause takes precedence when enabled.
baritone.fix.emergency-landing-fix.descr: Hide repetitive low-durability/firework landing messages while keeping other messages. Only affects chat; also enable Elytra flight compatibility for armor flight.
baritone.fix.enable-baritone-command-pro: Block messages beginning with # if Baritone is absent or uses a different command prefix.
fast-craft.drop-craft.description: Throw crafted output instead of moving it into the inventory.
chat-helper.add-to-history-when-close.de: Save unsent text in chat history when closing chat so it can be recalled later.
chat-helper.chat-message-escape-format.d: Messages matching this expression are excluded from message formatting.
chat-helper.chat-message-format-str.desc: Format outgoing messages; {randomN} inserts a random string of length N.
chat-helper.dont-send-empty-message.desc: Do not send empty messages or empty commands.
chat-helper.enable-tab-fix.description: Expose tab suggestions without requiring a leading slash.
chat-helper.escape-trim-chat.description: Keep spaces at the start and end of outgoing chat.
chat-helper.ignore-chat-len-limit.descri: Remove the local input limit; the server may still reject oversized messages.
Match commands containing a password. Use capture group 1 for the command and group 2 for its password.
chat-screen-tools.password-encrypt.descr: Transform matched password arguments using the configured salt. Hold Control or prefix a password with plain: to compat.
chat-screen-tools.password-encrypt-lengt: Changing the output length changes generated passwords. Keep it consistent for existing accounts.
Changing the salt changes generated passwords. Keep it consistent for existing accounts.
client-side-command.client-side-give.des: Handle supported /give commands locally in creative mode using creative inventory actions.
chat-helper.chat-box-in-gui.description: Add a chat input field while a container screen is open.
chat-helper.chat-box-other-length: Chat field width on other screens
chat-helper.chat-box-other-length.descri: Chat field width on other screens.

combat-bot.elytra-bot.mace-follow-and-at: Maximum tolerated height below the target while following; greater differences trigger climbing.
Blends predicted Y with current Y: predicted Y * weight + current Y * (1 - weight).
Below this horizontal distance to the target, aim straight down instead.
When the target is below you, use the lerped Y as the follow reference.
When the dive direction is shallower than this, additionally check that the predicted movement still reaches attack range.
Beyond the start distance, chase the predicted position instead of the current one.
